import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set working directory and paths
input_dir = "input"
submission_dir = "submission"
train_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv")
test_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv")
sample_sub_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")
sub_output_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

# Identify target column and feature columns from TRAINING data
train_target_col = "species"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", train_target_col]]

print(f"Total classes: {len(np.unique(train_df[train_target_col]))}")
print(f"Number of features per image: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Get unique species names for consistent ordering
class_names = sorted(list(train_df[train_target_col].unique()))

# Create label encoding mapping
class_name_to_idx = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(class_names)}
total_classes = len(class_names)

# Prepare training data
y_train = train_df[train_target_col].astype(str).values
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Split training data into training and validation (50/50 split for fair hold-out)
# IMPORTANT: Use this same split for evaluation later
X_train_set, X_val_set, y_train_set, y_val_set = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.3, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Training set size: {len(X_train_set)}, Validation set size: {len(X_val_set)}")

# Train logistic regression model on training data ONLY (never touches validation)
model = LogisticRegression(
    multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, C=1.0, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train_set, y_train_set)


# Evaluate on validation set using OFFICIAL multi-class log-loss metric
# Formula: -(1/N)*sum(sum(y_ij * log(p_ij))) where y_ij is ONE-HOT encoded
def calculate_logloss(y_true_one_hot, y_pred_proba):
    """Compute multi-class log loss"""
    # Clip probabilities to avoid log(0)
    p_clipped = np.clip(y_pred_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

    # One-hot encode y_true
    n_samples = len(y_true_one_hot)
    n_classes = y_pred_proba.shape[1]
    y_true_ohe = np.zeros((n_samples, n_classes))
    for i, label in enumerate(y_true_one_hot):
        y_true_ohe[i, int(label)] = 1

    # Compute log loss
    log_probs = np.log(p_clipped)
    loss = -np.sum(y_true_ohe * log_probs) / n_samples
    return float(loss)


y_val_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_set)

# Calculate proper one-hot encoded validation labels for accurate log loss
y_val_labels = y_val_set.reshape(-1)
y_val_ohe = np.zeros((len(y_val_labels), total_classes))
for i, label in enumerate(y_val_labels):
    y_val_ohe[i, class_name_to_idx[label]] = 1

val_logloss = calculate_logloss(y_val_ohe, y_val_pred_probs)
print(f"\n=== VALIDATION METRIC ===")
print(f"Held-out Validation Log-Loss: {round(val_logloss, 5)}")

# ============================================
# GENERATE SUBMISSION FOR TEST DATA
# ============================================

test_id = test_df["id"].values
test_features = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Get prediction probabilities for test data
test_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(test_features)

# Build submission dataframe matching sample_submission format
num_rows = len(test_id)
submission_data = np.zeros((num_rows, total_classes), dtype=np.float32)

# Ensure we include 'id' column properly in submission format
# Map sample_submission's columns to species predictions
species_cols = [col for col in sample_sub.columns if col != "id"]
num_species_cols = len(species_cols)
assert (
    num_species_cols == total_classes
), f"Expected {total_classes} species cols, got {num_species_cols}"

# Initialize array
submission_data = np.zeros((num_rows, num_species_cols), dtype=np.float32)

for row in range(num_rows):
    probs = test_pred_probs[row]
    prob_sum = np.sum(probs)

    # Normalize so they sum to 1 (as required by instructions)
    normalized_probs = probs / (prob_sum + 1e-15)

    for col_idx in range(num_species_cols):
        submission_data[row, col_idx] = normalized_probs[col_idx]

# Format submission with header matching sample_sub
column_headers = list(sample_sub.columns)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    submission_data, columns=column_headers, index=test_id.values
)

# Ensure submission is saved to correct location
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv(sub_output_path, index=False)

# Print final validation metric (this is what will be used for grading estimation)
print(f"\nFinal Held-out Validation Metric: {round(val_logloss, 5)}")
